Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a student position on the Bellevue Community College board of trustees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a student position on the BellevueCommunity College board of trustees; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) Bellevue Community College shallcreate a pilot program to establish a student position on the BellevueCommunity College board of trustees for the period of two yearsbeginning July 1, 2008, and expiring June 30, 2010. (b) The governor shall select the student member from a list ofcandidates, of at least three and not more than five, submitted by thegoverning body of the associated students. The student member shall beappointed by the governor with the consent of the senate. (c) The student member shall be a student in good standing atBellevue Community College at the time of appointment. (d) The student member shall hold his or her office for a term ofone year, from July 1, 2008, until June 30, 2009, or until the studentmember's successor is appointed and qualified, whichever is later. (2) A student appointed under this section shall excuse himself orherself from participation or voting on matters relating to the hiring,discipline, or tenure of faculty members and personnel. p. 1 SB 6699 (3) Bellevue Community College, in consultation with the governingbody of associated students, shall create criteria by which the pilotprogram shall be evaluated. Bellevue Community College, inconsultation with the body of associated students, shall report to theappropriate committees of the legislature by December 1, 2009, on thestatus of the pilot project based on the criteria established in thissection. The report shall include recommendations on whether thestudent position shall be made permanent.
